2610.11966.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
2610.11966.paper_summary: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.
2610.11966.paper_summary_zh: 研究想法創新是科學進步的基本引擎，但在可擴展和可控的方式下生成和評估仍然困難。這一挑戰在於其固有的開放性和多目標性質，想法應該平衡新穎性、合理性和可行性。儘管最近基於大型語言模型的方法通過精心設計的提示或代理管道取得了進展，但它們受到預定義的靜態創意工作流程的限制。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了MindFlow，一個明確將創意表述為心智中的圖結構流的框架，該框架由模塊化思維運算符組成，並由概率心智超網絡建模。給定一個研究主題，控制器動態地抽樣思維流以生成候選想法。這一開放性問題通過基於比賽的相對排名進行優化，使控制器能夠逐步偏好更高質量的思維流。我們進一步引入了一種評估協議，聯合評估問題發現和問題解決，超越僅基於標題或摘要的判斷。在多樣的主題中，MindFlow顯示出其作為一個明確、可控和可優化的研究想法創新者的優越性。
